mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task ( project_id, title, description, priority, status, deadline, creator_id, assignee_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{deadline}, #{creatorId}, #{assigneeId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, title, description, priority, status, deadline, creator_id AS creatorId, assignee_id AS assigneeId, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM task WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, priority = #{priority}, deadline = #{deadline}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
